items.summary: CFO recommendation: reject both new product proposals this cycle and authorize no incremental spend. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, and 21 requests failed. Preserve only canonical repair and already-approved work after capacity clearance. Financial claims remain unsupported: Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission entirely in an aggregate unattributed row; site-attributed income is $0. Site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are therefore unknown. AI usage on 2026-10-01 is $2.2785467 across 16 calls, but only 4 of 38 expected sites are covered; do not extrapolate or call this fleet cost. Fixed costs, infrastructure spend, labor cost, monthly budget, and revenue targets are blank, so budget exposure and fleet contribution margin are not calculable. Minimum measurement: dated site-level revenue by registered tracking ID; AI, infrastructure, domain, and any paid-media costs by site and period; and experiment exposure/control with incremental conversions and commission. Until those exist, report revenue as partially attributable, margin as unknown, and forecasts as unsupported. Do not move money, alter billing, access banking, sign contracts, or change gates.

Retain the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case and existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request only after capacity and overlap clearance. Require financial acceptance evidence before any ROI or revenue claim: preserve the 2026-09-21 allthingsmasonic.com baseline of 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission; measure the same fields after the normal window; and label unavailable revenue or causal lift unknown. Do not add tracking or spend.
